deliverables well ahead of schedule. M Competence Very good expertise in Data Analytics techniques. Please	provide	details/examples	of expertise. The candidate has strong expertise in data analytics, with hands-on experience using Excel (including Power Query, Pivot Tables), SAP ERP, and Alteryx for audit and compliance testing. General Auditor: Governance Risk Management Corporate	Strategic	Planning and Performance Management Finance Human Resources Procurement and Contracts Prior experience in Engineering Audit in the Energy Sector for Category 2 The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: Technical Auditor: Supply	Chain	and	Materials Management Inventory and Warehouse Production and Operations Process Safety Maintenance Asset Integrity Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineering Management Measurement and Metering Laboratory Operations Investments	and	Project Management Behavioral Good judgment and analytical skills (big picture) Please provide examples. During an audit of a solar energy client, the candidate identified unexplained variances in inventory reports related to solar panels and inverters. Leveraging SAP data and Excel trend analysis, the candidate uncovered over-reporting caused by manual consolidation errors across warehouses. The Candidate recommended an automated reconciliation tracker, which improved inventory accuracy and enhanced reporting reliability. During an audit of a hospitality group, the candidate identified inconsistencies in POS revenue and cash handling. Instead of escalating prematurely

, the candidate used Excel-based reconciliation and trend comparison across outlets. His findings led to improved oversight controls and the implementation of standardized cash-handling SOPs across the chain. M

Behavioral Strong organizational skills (scheduling meetings, adequate and timely working papers). Please elaborate / provide examples. The candidate displayed excellent organizational skills while managing 30 walkthrough meetings within 3 months during peak audit season. Despite stakeholders’ limited availability, the candidate proactively scheduled sessions across global time zones, ensured timely follow-ups, and coordinated with process owners efficiently. The Candidate also prepared and circulated detailed meeting minutes, completed walkthrough checklists, and maintained audit documentation aligned with internal quality standards. His structured approach ensured that all walkthroughs were completed on time without compromising audit quality. While working with multiple clients simultaneously, the candidate demonstrated strong time and task management by organizing audit planning, execution, and documentation without delays. The Candidate ensured timely preparation and review of working papers, maintained version control and adhered to internal review timelines, which helped avoid last-minute escalations during external reviews. M Behavioral Ability to work independently with minimum instructions and supervision from the Lead

Auditor. Has (s)he led many assignments before? Size of assignments that were led. The candidate has consistently demonstrated the ability to work independently with minimal supervision. The Candidate has successfully led multiple internal audits and SOX assignments across industries such as logistics, renewable energy, hospitality, and exports. The Candidate managed end-to-end engagements—from planning and walkthroughs to fieldwork, documentation, and reporting—for assignments covering 8 to 12 key business processes. His leadership included managing testing activities, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality audit deliverables without significant oversight. The candidate independently managed end-to-end SOX testing for 40–50 controls across key business cycles, including PTP, OTC, Inventory, and Payroll. The Candidate conducted walkthroughs, performed control testing, documented results, and followed up on exceptions with minimal supervision. Through proactive planning and disciplined execution, the candidate consistently met corporate deadlines and often completed

analysis, and control testing. For example, the candidate automated a reconciliation template using Power Query to track inventory variances across multiple warehouse locations, significantly reducing manual effort and increasing accuracy in audit testing. P Competence Good knowledge and use of SAP ERP system The candidate has a strong working knowledge of the SAP ERP system, primarily using it for audit and control testing purposes. The Candidate has extracted and analyzed PTP, Inventory, and Fixed Assets data to perform walkthroughs, validate control effectiveness, and identify process gaps. For example, the candidate used SAP to review asset capitalization entries and depreciation runs during a fixed assets audit, identifying incorrect asset class mapping instances and improving financial reporting accuracy. P Communication Strong written and oral communication skills (in English). This includes the ability to prepare high quality Audit Memos with recommendations. Provide examples of types of reports prepared. The candidate has strong written and oral communication skills in English, demonstrated through preparing high-quality audit deliverables

. The Candidate has drafted audit memos, risk and control matrices (RCMs), walkthrough documentation, and executive-level summary reports. His reports include clear issue descriptions, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations. For example, the candidate prepared detailed audit memos highlighting control gaps in PTP and Inventory processes, which were well-received by senior stakeholders and used to drive remediation actions. M Communication Excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, including the ability to interact with all levels of management and employees. Provide examples of levels of management and employees that have been interacted with in the past. The candidate has excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, demonstrated through regular interactions with stakeholders across various levels—from junior staff to senior management. The Candidate has conducted control walkthroughs, process interviews, and follow-up discussions professionally and collaboratively. For example, during a large-scale SOX assignment, the candidate independently led over 30 walkthrough meetings across departments,
built a strong rapport with process owners, and was able to extract key insights critical to evaluating control design and effectiveness. M
Location Is the resource based in Qatar or outside? No, the resource is from Bengaluru, India. P
